comment: Known problem signatures matched against free-text diagnostics (e.g. PyTorch import errors). Matching is substring-based and intentionally conservative; advice strings are suggestions only.

torch_import.title: PyTorch cannot load the NVIDIA driver library
torch_import.advice: The CUDA userland is installed, but the NVIDIA driver library cannot be found. Install or reinstall the NVIDIA driver; on Linux also check that /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu (or the driver's lib directory) contains libcuda.so.1 and that LD_LIBRARY_PATH does not shadow it with a different CUDA version.

torch_import.title: PyTorch cannot find the CUDA runtime it was built against
torch_import.advice: The torch installation appears broken or was copied between environments. Reinstall the PyTorch wheel that matches your platform (https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally).

torch_import.title: Possible binary incompatibility inside PyTorch
torch_import.advice: An 'undefined symbol' at import usually means mixed CUDA versions (e.g. torch built for one CUDA major version loading libraries from another). Reinstall PyTorch in a fresh virtual environment and avoid mixing pip wheels with conda CUDA packages.
